regulations.title: Medical electrical equipment - Part 1: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance
European version of IEC60601-1 with amendments

semantic_fragments.content: Compliance with 9.8.1 and 9.8.2 confirmed by examination of ME EQUIPMENT, RISK MANAGEMENT FILE, specifications and material processing. When tests were conducted, testing consisted of application of a test load to support assembly equal to TOTAL LOAD times required TENSILE SAFETY FACTOR while support assembly under test was in equilibrium after 1 min, or not resulted in an unacceptable RISK.

For clause 9.8.3.2(a): PATIENT support/suspension system positioned horizontally in most disadvantageous position in NORMAL USE, and a mass 2 x 135 kg or twice intended persons load (the greater used), applied to foot rest over an area of 0.1 m2 for 1 min. Damage or deflection greater than 5° from normal did not occur. BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE was maintained.

For clause 9.8.3.2(b): PATIENT support/suspension system set in most unfavourable NORMAL USE position, and a mass of 60% of part of SAFE WORKING LOAD simulating PATIENT or OPERATOR, or a min 80 kg, placed on support or suspension system with centre of load 60 mm from outer edge of support or suspension system for at least 1 min. Deflection of support/suspension from normal greater than 5° did not occur, and BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE was maintained.

Supporting and suspending parts for adult human PATIENTS or OPERATORS shall be designed for a PATIENT or OPERATOR with a minimum mass of 135 kg and ACCESSORIES with a minimum mass of 15 kg, unless otherwise stated by MANUFACTURER. Maximum allowable PATIENT mass less than 135 kg shall be marked on ME EQUIPMENT and stated in ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS. Maximum allowable PATIENT mass greater than 135 kg shall be stated in ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS.
